root_text: Jharkhand is home to several indigenous tribes, each with rich cultural traditions. Prominent tribes include the Santhal, Munda, Ho, Oraon, Kharia, and Gond. Known for their deep connection to nature. #TribesOfJharkhand #IndigenousCulture #
